title: FRK's Hytale
description: Minecraft and Hytale in the same pack!
body:
# FRK's Hytale

[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-NA?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=000000&color=00AF5C)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/hytalemc)[![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/curseforge-gray?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&labelColor=222222&color=888888)](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/fhytale)

# This modpack adds the recently released Hytale game to Minecraft in a similar way.
It adds exploration mechanics from Fantastic Combat and Hytale. Is that all? No!

- New animals and monsters
- New places to explore
- New animations and movements
- Biomes
- Worlds
- New Dungeons

### Compatibility and Version
Minecraft Version : 1.20.1
